basis: Acquired hypertrophic cardiomyopathy directly affects cardiac muscle; systemic causes vary across subtypes.
Congenital absence of fibrinogen causes a coagulation disorder; frequent joint swelling does not establish chronic destructive arthropathy.
Acute myeloid leukemia is a malignant blood and bone marrow disorder; the translocation does not establish additional organ involvement.
Benign perivascular glomus-cell proliferation associated with dilated vascular spaces; no specific skin or skeletal-muscle location is established.
Deficiency anemia is defined by impaired red-cell or hemoglobin production; nutritional causes do not independently establish a metabolic disorder.
Hereditary photodermatosis with cutaneous photosensitivity and freckling in the reported patient; no extracutaneous dysfunction is established.
Mild ichthyosis vulgaris is a skin-barrier and keratinization disorder.
Fanconi anemia with marrow hypocellularity and multiple cytopenias; microcephaly and short stature alone do not establish additional functional organ damage.
Congenital skeletal myopathy with weakness and possible contractures; neuromuscular transmission defects are optional, with no qualifying frequency given.
Sensory neuropathy; osteolysis, reduced bone density and muscle atrophy occur in 80–99%; chronic nail dystrophy occurs in 80–99%.
Developmental impairment and epilepsy affect all reported patients; optic atrophy and iris coloboma each occur in 1/4, below 30%.
Paralysis of the third cranial nerve; impaired eye movement and ptosis reflect nerve dysfunction without establishing intrinsic ocular damage.
Inherited iron-overload disorder with characteristic hepatic iron accumulation and injury; cardiac injury and destructive arthropathy vary across genotypes.
Cataract directly affects the lens nucleus and impairs lens transparency.
Partial trisomy 21 commonly produces developmental and cognitive impairment; cardiac and other malformations depend on the duplicated segment.
Congenital narrowing directly affects the inferior vena cava; no additional organ injury is established.
Mature B-cell malignancy encompassing lymphomas and related blood-cell neoplasms; extranodal organ involvement varies by subtype.
Excess erythropoietin causes increased red-cell mass; this does not itself establish endocrine-gland disease or renal injury.
Tumor of the endocrine pancreas; VIP secretion and its clinical syndrome are optional, and diarrhea alone does not establish intestinal injury.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with azoospermia and reduced testicular size; reproductive dysfunction without established hormonal disease has no axis.
Localized skin disease characterized by hypopigmentation and fine scaling; no established systemic immune-mediated disease.
Umbrella disorder of white blood cells; infection, immunodeficiency, autoimmunity and lymphoma are subtype-specific mechanisms.
Defined by global developmental delay and impaired cognitive, speech and motor development; less frequent visual impairment lacks a qualifying frequency.
Occipital focal epilepsy; visual hallucinations and ictal blindness arise from cerebral seizures rather than direct ocular injury.
Hereditary renal disease associated with preauricular pits; pits alone do not establish functional ear injury or hearing impairment.
